import json,pathlib,hashlib
P=pathlib.Path(__file__).parent
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
f=json.loads((P/'freeze.json').read_text())
for path,h in f['files'].items():assert sha(pathlib.Path(path))==h,path
for path,t in f['symlinks'].items():assert str(pathlib.Path(path).readlink())==t,path
assert not (P/'DO_NOT_RUN').exists()
assert '2 passed; 0 failed' in (P/'packet-tests.log').read_text()
assert '16 mutations' in (P/'validator-tests.log').read_text()
assert 'PASS actual manifest/row/scratch/primary/cross/prior-reader' in (P/'reader-positive-tests.log').read_text()
r=json.loads((P/'readiness.json').read_text());assert r['ready'] and r['compiled_context']==65536 and r['prefix']==1024
assert r['host']['sha256']=='12bf0ef317f1ddb903baf7260aaffa069c47478322905f0fd16f96c0c6d6b25c'
q=json.loads((P/'numerical-queue.json').read_text());assert len(q['jobs'])==30
for j in q['jobs']:
 if j['kind']=='block_numerical':
  assert not pathlib.Path(j['output']).exists(),'fresh output required'
  assert j['env']['PLOW_VMM_LIVE']=='1' and j['env']['PLOW_VMM_LIVE_RINGS']=='1'
  assert j['env']['PLOW_PREFIX_CACHE']=='0' and j['env']['PLOW_VMM_PREFIX']=='0'
  assert j['command'][j['command'].index('--block-prefix')+1]=='1024'
  assert j['command'][j['command'].index('--input-batch')+1]==str(j['M'])
  assert j['validator_command']==['/usr/bin/python3',str(P/'validate.py'),'--primary',j['arm'],'--m',str(j['M']),'--seed',str(j['seed'])]
for m in [1,4,8,16]:
 a=P/f'ready-m{m}-down';b=P/f'ready-m{m}-oproj';assert sha(a/'interp_sm90a.cubin')==sha(b/'interp_sm90a.cubin')
 for pf in a.glob('interp_sm90a_pf*.cubin'):assert sha(pf)==sha(b/pf.name)
 if m==1:assert sha(a/'model.pkt')==sha(b/'model.pkt')
 else:
  proof=json.loads((b/'model.proof.json').read_text());assert proof['canonical_instructions_dependencies_equal_to_original'] and proof['live_kv_layout_identical']
  assert proof['rungs'][-1]['rewritten']==1 and proof['rungs'][-1]['mapped_dependency_sets_equal']
print('PASS30job queue; two independent scratch lifetimes, exactpreop/boundeddownstream gates; no production/GPU change')
